intuition.title: Authors’ proposed disk-assembly picture
intuition.summary: For columnar CuS disk assembly, the authors discuss packing entropy and face-to-face van der Waals contact, with dipole interactions at polar {001} faces and possible preferential amine binding as further contributions. These explanations are not measurements of ligand occupancy or facet-specific binding.
